sessions.phase_label: Test blog review and editorial revision
Client feedback and follow-on landing-page assignment

requirements.title: Test Blog Editorial Revision
requirements.definition: Revise the Century Spring test blog in accordance with editorial feedback, including stronger storytelling and engaging introductions that break up long informational lists, without treating 1,000 words as a hard maximum.
requirements.boundary_note: The storytelling direction, requested feedback edits, and flexible word target are acceptance attributes of the same revised article deliverable; unspecified linked-document comments cannot safely be decomposed into additional Requirements.

requirements.title: Compression Springs Landing-Page Copy Update
requirements.definition: Update the copy on Century Spring's existing compression-springs landing page according to section-specific instructions supplied in the assignment brief.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a separate deliverable from the test blog; rates, estimated effort, delivery lead time, meeting arrangements, and expected monthly assignment cadence are project-management facts and are excluded.

unresolved_candidates.description: The linked documents contain editorial comments not reproduced in the message history, so any additional independently evolving content requirements within those comments cannot be identified safely.
